title: Console Gaming Ruled. Then Phones Beat It.
source: Global video game market revenue by segment, from Newzoo Global Games Market Reports as compiled by TechCrunch, Fortune and Statista. Console: $24.0B (2012), $25.5B (2014), $26.4B (2015), $33.5B (2017), $34.0B (2018), $50.4B (2021). Mobile: $9.0B (2012), $25.0B (2014), $30.3B (2015), $46.1B (2017), $70.3B (2018), $93.2B (2021). Mobile overtook console revenue globally in 2015 and has led every year since.
